content.title: How To Watch The Oscars
content.text: See it for free over-the-air on your local ABC station. If you’re a cable or satellite subscriber, ABC is part of your lineup. Stream It Subscribe instantly with streaming services like Hulu Live TV, YouTubeTV, AT&T TV and FuboTV– many of these services offer a free trial as well. Watch on ABC.COM and the ABC app by authenticating with your provider Select your tv provider TV provider may vary based on zip code. watching outside the U.S. Outside of the U.S.? The show is broadcast in more than 200 territories worldwide. Click Here to check your international local listings. Your Oscar Sunday schedule Oscars Red Carpet Preshow 6:30 PM ET | 3:30 PM PT Actor Vanessa Hudgens, actor Terrence J and fashion designer Brandon Maxwell will host the “The Oscars® Red Carpet Show,” the official lead-in to the 94th Oscars. The 90-minute special will highlight Oscar® nominees, performers and presenters and give fans around the world the ultimate insiders’ sneak peek at Hollywood’s biggest night. The show will feature a special appearance by DJ M.O.S. “The Oscars Red Carpet Show” is executive produced by David Chamberlin and Michael Antinoro, alongside producers Packer and Cowan The Oscars 8pm ET | 5pm PT The star lineup includes Stephanie Beatriz, DJ Khaled, Jennifer Garner, H.E.R., Tiffany Haddish, Tony Hawk, Bill Murray, Elliot Page, Kelly Slater and Shaun White, Halle Bailey, Ruth E.
